goal: Every live sw factory agent with an area works the way the owner set in c249: it keeps two common duties, a board push every 3 hours (its check-in at 180 min or less, GET /api/agents/<id>/check-in planEveryMs) and a daily duty named "Area review" (seeded by duty-rule, precheck apps/chat/scripts/duties/area-review.ts). Both run on time, both produce work, no duty is paused or overdue, and a live duty covers each area it was given. The precheck (apps/chat/scripts/duties/agent-boards.ts --part duties, agentPattern) reads each agent's duties, brief, check-in, stuck steps and board time over :5184. A board push is late when the check-in has no run in 2 of its intervals, counted from the later of its last run and the time its plan got an open step (planOpenSince), because the server runs it daily while the plan has no open step: on 11-28 fable auditor read late 18 s after its first step opened. It is empty when the board holds stuck steps and has not changed in 24 h. An Area review run is empty when it started no job and its readings wiki_pages_touched_24h and memory_changed_24h are 0. A duty is live when it is not paused, has a measured run and has run within 2 of its intervals; duties_paused and duties_overdue list each paused duty and each duty with no run for over 2 of its intervals, as fable auditor's d2 did on 11-26 (~/.pi/agent/agents/fable-auditor/duties/keep-responsibilities.py). An area comes from the brief or from ~/work/agent-duties/areas.json (a list of {agent, areas: [{area, source, duty}]}, or an object of agent: {areas, missing}); an area that names no live duty is uncovered. An agent with no brief and no area from the owner (a source of "none found" is a placeholder) has no area and is left out, as feature probe was on 11-26. The output's messages list holds one nudge per agent off the pattern. Fable auditor's census on 11-26 (#sw-factory-build p236): 4 agents had no duty, none of the other 14 had an area review, and no agent had a real 3-hourly board push. Since the owner's p237 ("agents folder full of slop clean up", msg mwwksq7v) the precheck also reads the wiki on this box from ~/.config/sieun-pi/wiki.json and counts wiki_clutter: each folder under the agents/ mount (~/.pi/agent/agents) that belongs to no live agent, such as test, deleted and blind agents (TEMPLATE stays), and each dated one-off page in apps/, domains/ and projects/ whose path carries a date or a session, job or run stamp and that no curated page links to. On 11-26 before the cleanup it read 517 orphan agent folders, 253 of them blind-replies, and 6 dated pages under domains/devops. Since fable auditor's 11-26 audit it also counts four misses. asks_unheld: the owner's standing asks to an agent that no duty names by the post's msg id, its "#room pN" ref or its first 40 characters. A word match only finds candidates: his DM posts to an agent after its brief, and group posts that tag it or reach it untagged as a member, with words such as keep watching, daily, every day, monitor the, 계속 확인 or 매일. The sorted-asks file ~/work/agent-duties/asks.json decides each candidate (agent-boards.ts readAsks): an entry in standing ({ref, msg, agent, why}) makes it an ask for that one agent, an entry in one_time ({ref, msg, why}) drops it, and a post in neither list that no duty names is flagged ask_unsorted for the duty job to sort and counts in asks_unsorted, not in agents_off_pattern. On 11-28 the words read #sw-factory-build p250, a design question, and #1124-cost-management p33, a one-time chart change, as asks, and p33 put its room's three members off the pattern. pauses_stale: a paused duty older than a day whose reason, the sentence on the board or in its goal that names the pause and the duty, names a condition (until, while, once, when, after), else one older than 7 days; Crawler guy's d6, d8 and d9 stayed paused about 45 h after the paid proxy came back. met_on_zero: a duty whose newest run read met with a sample size n of 0 in its detail file, as mcp's d1 read 100% success on 6 of 7 days with no customer call; runs_without_n counts the newest runs whose detail names no n. misses_unfixed_24h: the misses this duty flagged over a day ago that it still flags, with no job of that agent at work since. agents_off_pattern counts only the real misses (a common duty missing or late, an empty run, an uncovered area, an unheld ask, a stale pause, a met run on n = 0); runs_without_n is a reading of its own and common_duties_missing a reading inside agents_off_pattern, since on 11-26 no precheck wrote n yet and all 18 agents read off the pattern on it alone. An agent with no brief, no area in the file and no ongoing owner ask has no area whatever duties it has. duplicate_jobs counts the extra jobs one duty started for the same hand-off sig, which the duty runner (server/duty-run.ts measure) stops since 11-26. Since the owner's #1124-cost-management p60 (msg mx0bgshc, 11-28) the precheck also reads whether each agent's checks and fixes work (apps/chat/scripts/duties/duty-health.ts), in three counted metrics. checks_blind: ~/work/agent-duties/past-problems.json lists real past problems a duty covered and did not name ({id, agent, duty, what, when, source, replay}); the precheck runs each replay with sh -c from that folder, where exit 0 means today's check flags the old problem and exit 1 that it ran and did not, and counts the exit 1 ones. An entry with replay null, another exit code or no end in 60 s is not measured: with no known miss beside it the metric gets no value, so the run reads not measured and never met. problems_returned: the duty metrics of any agent that read missed right after a met reading 2 or more times in 14 days, each within 14 days after a fix step for that metric closed (a done plan step with duty <d>/<metric>, timed by its updatedAt, which steps carry since 11-25 20:41Z). A metric that stays red through its fix steps never left and is no return. ~/work/agent-duties/returns.json settles one: lasting ({agent, duty, metric, at, why}) names the lasting cause fixed at that time, and returns before it no longer count; new_work ({agent, duty, metric, why}) names a metric that turns red whenever new work arrives. duty_system_faults: per duty that is not paused, each fault its newest measured run shows: the precheck failed or ran past its timeoutMs, the run left a metric with no value while no box was away and no outside wait was named, the duty reads missed with no job on the run and no fix step at work, its newest job ended and its report never reached the work thread, or one job holds it: its not-met streak is older than 24 h and 3 or more of its runs started no job and gave the job its newest run names nothing while that job waited for no model account (duty-health.ts heldJobs). On 11-28 that was devops guy's d17, whose one job stood behind 7 runs in 62 h while PostHog Events and the OpenAI credits went over pace and reached no job; since then the duty runner steers a working job with each new item and replaces one past its stuck limit (server/duty-items.ts). These three put no agent off the pattern and nudge nobody, because on 11-26 one new count put all 18 agents off the pattern and hid the real misses. Readings with no target: duty_jobs_waiting_account (pi-pool's line, held on the owner's account todos), precheck_failed_runs_24h, unmeasured_runs_24h, fixes_blaming_check_24h (fix steps closed in 24 h whose words say the check was wrong, a word match that found 8 of 31 known ones) duties_met_leaving_out (a duty that reads met while its goal or a flagged kind of its newest run names something left out, as d17's goal left out PostHog's unpriced rows) and duties_held_in_streak (duties whose not-met streak holds 3 or more such runs behind any one job, also a job that ended or only waited for an account; 3 on 11-28: devops guy d17, 5180 designer d1 and agent factory d2). wiki_clutter, misses_unfixed_24h and runs_without_n are readings since 11-28: a run that finds clutter still starts the duty job, the headline already counts the misses that misses_unfixed_24h repeats, and the duty runner hands a missing n to a job itself. Fable auditor's d6 finds new waste across the app; this duty judges whether each agent's own checks and fixes work.

metrics.label: Agents with an area that miss a common duty, run one late or empty, keep a paused or overdue duty, or leave an area with no live duty
Real past problems (past-problems.json) that the owning agent's check would still miss when replayed
Duty metrics that went red again 2 or more times in 14 days after a fix step for them closed
Duties the duty system did not keep: a failed precheck, an unmeasured run, a red duty with no job, a job whose report was lost, or a duty one job holds

onMiss: Fix what you can yourself, then nudge the rest through the work thread. Never add a common duty to an agent listed as no_area (agents_without_area): it owns nothing to review, and on 11-26 an Area review and a 180 min check-in given to feature probe had to be removed. 1. A common_missing item for the board push: set the agent's check-in with POST /api/agents/<id>/check-in {everyMs: 10800000}, unless it is paused on purpose by the owner. 2. A common_missing item for the Area review: add it with legacy/prime/user-history/scripts/duties/add.ts <agent id> <the Area review duty json duty-rule's backfill uses>, run from inside ~/.local/share/sieun-pi-apps-chat/current/apps/chat/scripts/duties. 3. For everything else, such as a late or empty run, a paused or overdue duty or an area with no live duty, the agent acts itself. A precheck and a duty job do not message agents. Write the run's messages list (the precheck output's messages, edited to drop what you fixed in steps 1 and 2) to ~/work/agent-duties/messages-<run stamp>.json in the shape of ~/work/agent-duties/messages.json ({agent, name, workThreadId, text}), and end your report with its path, so the work thread relays each one. 4. When the same miss comes back for an agent after a nudge, fix the cause in the shared text: the sw-factory skill (skills/sw-factory/SKILL.md), the board skill, the role text (packages/pi-host/src/durable/agent-profile.ts) or the duty seeding in apps/chat/server, with a test, a push and a release. Never pause, remove or close another agent's duties or steps to turn the number green. When an agent's areas change, update ~/work/agent-duties/areas.json with the area, its source message id and the duty that watches it. 5. Each orphan_agent_folder and dated_page item names a wiki path. An orphan agent folder comes from a test or blind agent that was not cleaned up: find which check made it (its name prefix, such as blind-replies or restart-walk) and fix that check to delete its folder when it ends, with a test, a push and a release. Move a dated page into the agent's session folder or fold its facts into the curated page of its area, through the wiki API, and tell the agent that owns the area. 6. An ask_unheld, pause_stale, met_on_zero or no_sample_size item goes in the agent's nudge: it adds a daily duty that quotes the ask with its msg id, rechecks the pause reason and resumes the duty when the reason is gone, or adds n, the count of things the run measured, to its precheck output. 7. A miss_unfixed_24h item means a nudge went nowhere for a day: start a job that fixes it, or steer the agent's work thread again. Leave agent factory's own items, its d2 and d5 and the sw-factory pages, to the jobs that own them. A duplicate_job item is the duty runner's bug, not the agent's: fix server/duty-run.ts, and nudge nobody. 8. An ask_unsorted item is an owner post whose words may ask for ongoing care, and you decide it, not the word list. Read the post and its thread with read_post, or from the posts table of ~/.pi/agent/chat/chat.sqlite. Decide whether he asks for ongoing care, a review, watch or report that repeats, or for a one-time change, question or fix. Then add one entry to ~/work/agent-duties/asks.json with a one-line why: to standing as {ref, msg, agent, why}, where agent is the id of the one agent the ask is for, the one he tags or whose area it is and not every member of the room, or to one_time as {ref, msg, why}. Copy ref and msg from the item, change only your entry and keep the file valid JSON, because the precheck fails on another shape and on an agent that GET /api/agents?archived=1 does not list. A standing entry that no duty names reads as ask_unheld for its agent on the next run, and step 6 applies to it. 9. A check_blind item is a real past problem that the owning agent's check would still miss today, and its Replay command reproduces it. Fix that check yourself when it is shared code (apps/chat/scripts/duties, legacy/prime/user-history/scripts/duties), with a test, a push and a release, or else put the exact change for the owning agent in the messages file, then run the replay again. A gap item names a past problem with no working replay: write the replay under ~/work/agent-duties/replays/<id>/ so it feeds that day's stored numbers to today's precheck, read-only and with no vendor call, and set it in the entry; when the precheck cannot take a stored day, send the owning agent the exact change that lets it. Whenever the owner or fable auditor (its reports under wiki agents/fable-auditor/ and its ledger duties/waste-found.json) finds a problem that an agent's duty covered and did not name that day, add an entry to ~/work/agent-duties/past-problems.json with its source and evidence, and replay null until one exists. Never delete an entry to turn the count green. 10. A problem_returned item lists a metric's closed fix steps and the times it went red again, worst first. Read those steps and the runs between them, and find the cause the fixes left in place; do not open one more fix of the same kind. Fix the lasting cause in shared code or text yourself, or send the owning agent the exact change, and once it holds add {agent, duty, metric, at, why} to lasting in ~/work/agent-duties/returns.json. Add {agent, duty, metric, why} to new_work only for a metric that counts work arriving each day, where each closed step was that day's work done on time. 11. A system_precheck_failed, system_not_measured, system_red_no_job, system_job_unreported or system_held_by_one_job item is the duty system's fault, whichever agent's duty shows it: fix it in the shared duty code or text (apps/chat/server/duty-run.ts and boards.ts, the shared prechecks, the sw-factory and board skills), with a test, a push and a release, never one agent at a time, and nudge nobody. The job_waits_account, fix_blames_check and met_leaving_out items are readings: read them for a shared cause, and start nothing for an account wait.
